summary.text: Mike Yin is a Democratic member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 16, serving since January 2019, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mike Yin earned a bachelor's degree in computer science from Carnegie Mellon University in 2007 and has worked as a senior software developer with Android.
Yin assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 7, 2019, and has served as state House minority leader since January 10, 2023.

For 2025-2026, Yin's committee assignments include the House Corporations, Elections and Political Subdivisions Committee, the House Labor, Health and Social Services Committee, the House Rules and Procedure Committee and the Management Council Committee.
Yin advanced from the Democratic primary on August 18, 2026.
In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, Yin listed top three priorities as protecting education funding, enabling more options for local communities and protecting public lands.
